name: Adductor
setup: Set the foam roller on the floor and lower the area onto it, hands or feet on the floor to take as much weight as you need.
cues: Roll slow: one inch a second along the roller.
Breathe out long whenever you find a spot worth staying on.
Keep the pressure where you can still breathe smoothly.

faults.fault: Rolling fast back and forth
faults.fix: Slow the roll right down: one inch a second along the roller.

faults.fault: Holding the breath on a tender spot
faults.fix: Take some weight back onto the floor and let the air out slowly.
